audience: inventory and sales teams using Rackbeat

useCases.title: Review products with low available stock
useCases.text: Search products and inspect available quantities, then open a product summary to review stock and pricing before planning replenishment.

useCases.title: Compare stock across warehouse locations
useCases.text: Compare stock and available quantities for one product across warehouse locations. Review a bounded portion of the result to see which locations need closer attention.

useCases.title: Check sales orders before shipping
useCases.text: Find sales orders by customer or status, review shipment and invoice status, and inspect a bounded page of line quantities and prices before planning next steps.

useCases.title: Find customer numbers for sales lookups
useCases.text: Find the customer number for a company, then use it to narrow sales orders for a focused account review.
